research_question: Did post-RCEP supplier-network growth differ with firms' pre-2020 exposure to previously separate regional trade-agreement architectures?
theory: RCEP creates a common rules-of-origin and cumulation framework across economies previously connected to China through separate ASEAN, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, or no-prior-FTA architectures. Firms already sourcing across more architectures had greater scope to benefit from institutional unification.
interpretation_limit: The measure is cross-agreement institutional readiness, not tariff utilization, certificate use, or a direct measure of value-added cumulation.

population.coverage: Firm has at least one valid foreign FactSet relationship episode during 2017-2024 and maps to the verified firm-year panel.
population.balanced_primary_panel: Require all five outcome years to avoid composition changes.

exposure.primary: Count of distinct pre-RCEP institutional supplier architectures represented by at least one active relationship: ASEAN-China FTA block, Australia-China FTA, New Zealand-China FTA, Korea-China FTA, and Japan with no prior China FTA.
exposure.secondary: Indicator for at least two represented architectures.
exposure.non_overlap: No 2020-2024 relationship status enters exposure construction.

outcomes.primary: asinh count of unique active RCEP supplier relationships in each firm-year.
secondary: asinh count of active RCEP supplier countries
RCEP share of active Asian supplier relationships
asinh count of new RCEP supplier entries
outcomes.zero_rule: Counts are zero for covered firm-years with no qualifying active link.

estimating_equations.static: Y_it = alpha_i + lambda_industry-year + beta(Post2022_t x ArchitectureCount_i) + error_it
estimating_equations.dynamic: Year interactions with ArchitectureCount, 2021 omitted, using the same fixed effects.
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: 999 permutations of the frozen exposure vector within pre-policy industry-by-size-tercile strata, seed 20260723; retain all draws.

identifying_assumption: Absent RCEP, within industries, 2022-2024 changes in RCEP supplier-link intensity would not differ systematically with frozen 2017-2019 architecture count after firm and industry-year fixed effects.

data_gate.exposure_support: At least 250 firms with one or more represented architectures and at least 40 firms with two or more.
data_gate.panel_support: At least 3,000 firms with all five outcome years and at least 100 positive primary outcomes in every year.
data_gate.strata_support: At least 15 industry groups and no more than 10 exposed firms in singleton permutation strata.
data_gate.failure_rule: Failure stops before pretrend or treatment-effect estimation.

identification_gate.pretrend: The 2020 exposure interaction, relative to 2021, has p >= 0.10.
identification_gate.economic_threshold: Absolute 2020 interaction <= 0.05 on the asinh-link scale per additional architecture.
identification_gate.warning: Only one clean lead is available; passing is necessary but not sufficient and will be disclosed as limited diagnostic power.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Failure stops before the post estimate, permutations, robustness, mechanisms, or heterogeneity.

evidence_gate.positive_result: Stratified randomization p < 0.05, same sign for the multi-architecture indicator and active-country outcome, and no single-industry sign reversal.
evidence_gate.inconclusive: Identification passes but the observed post interaction is ordinary under stratified exposure assignments.
evidence_gate.integrity: No outcome, architecture mapping, stratum, seed, industry, or exposure cutoff is selected after estimates are inspected.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before execution.
